a_replay_parity.evidence: All five regenerated A index hashes match. Held-out at 0.90: 358 tiles, F1 0.4311, IoU 0.2748, exact TP/FP/FN recorded; local provisional crop hashes still differ.

trusted_independent_val_audit.evidence: 0 independently verified target trail or distractor samples; zero trusted VAL traces frozen.

input_registration_and_pixel_identity.evidence: A replay index hashes and published held-out score match; local provisional crop hashes match 0/45. Exact 2021 and 2018 NAIP STAC eo:bands confirm RGBN. New fetch_naip outputs now tag band 4 undefined instead of alpha, but existing mosaics retain the old tag and broader nodata/mask semantics remain unresolved. W005/W023's 23.0047% valid fractions are explained by the eastern raster-footprint edge: 49/213 columns overlap the dataset and all in-footprint pixels are valid and nonzero. Local SIFT/RANSAC accepted 0/24 September 2018 pairs; manual stable-landmark registration and trail-date compatibility remain unverified. Municipal image-service band names are unknown.

split_footprint_independence.evidence: Recovered split has about 2.34 km2 summed pairwise cross-split tile-footprint overlap, including 0.401 km2 Park City VAL/held-out; geometric area, not nodata-valid overlap.

local_batch_12_fit.evidence: The Intel Arc 130V 8 GB batch-12 fit smoke check ran out of memory.

t4q-labelmask.required_gate: confirmed incorrect positive supervision in at least 8 TRAIN windows across 2 blocks and at least 1% of affected-area A-positive ground area
t4q-labelmask.evidence: No blinded independent TRAIN adjudication; verified qualifying windows and area are both 0/unknown.

t4q-labeladd.required_gate: at least 250 m of independently verified omitted tread across 8 TRAIN windows and 2 blocks
t4q-labeladd.evidence: No independent dated trail traces; qualifying length and windows are both 0/unknown.

t4q-hardneg.required_gate: verified recurring distractors in at least 8 TRAIN windows across 2 blocks and in trusted VAL evidence
t4q-hardneg.evidence: No verified distractor windows or frozen trusted VAL references.

t4q-weatherdrop.required_gate: at least 6 verified Park City snow and 6 bare VAL windows with tread; snow recall gap at least 0.10; terrain ablation loss at least 0.05; optical ablation within 0.05 without increased distractor burden
t4q-weatherdrop.evidence: Aggregate A VAL modality sensitivity is complete: terrain neutralization lowers F1 by 0.2142 and optical neutralization lowers F1 by 0.0610 at 0.90. No independently adjudicated snow/bare corridor windows or trusted tread/distractor references exist, so weather-specific recall and distractor-burden deltas are unsupported and the gate remains unmet.

t4q-tversky.required_gate: clear-image distractors in at least 6 trusted VAL windows across 2 blocks and no actionable label, alignment, or imagery defect
t4q-tversky.evidence: No trusted VAL distractor audit; registration and tile-pixel identity remain unverified.

decision: No training arm is justified. Preserve A; replay parity is not a label-quality or generalization result.
